description: This Java source file defines the `InstallApkSessionApi` activity, demonstrating how to perform application installation using the `PackageInstaller` Session API. It includes UI handling, session creation, APK addition, and intent handling for installation status.

classes.name: InstallApkSessionApi
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating app installation via the PackageInstaller Session API, including UI event handling and installation status processing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns the button click listener to start the APK installation process.

methods.name: addApkToInstallSession
methods.description: Adds the APK from assets to the installer session by copying its bytes into the session output stream.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles the result intents from package installation, displaying success or failure messages.
